meta.est_desc_rule: estimate line = (estVerb+' ' if present)+name+(' — '+option label if option)
meta.note: Full reference scope: every item and option from the battle-tested DRYscope catalog, ALL prices zero. Build your prices via prompts/03-derive-your-prices.md (cost model + your accepted invoices + tolerance-band reconcile). No proprietary data.
